warmPixels.policy: Checksums and native dimensions are structural checks. No accepted goldens, similarity threshold, art-quality acceptance or portable timing gate is inferred.

variance.interpretation: Percent changes are observed variance/trends. Paired runs and repeated cohorts are required before attributing a regression. GPU subsets have explicit counts; software and changed settings cannot satisfy a hardware gate.

gpuTiming.method: Direct-queue ticks * 1000 / frequency; readback only after submission fence completion. Warmup fences excluded. Latest completed diagnostics may skip intermediate fences; sample counts are explicit. Passes can overlap and must not be summed.

run.coldScope: Fresh per-case renderers; process/device/runtime catalog and OS caches can already be warm. No OS/driver cache flush.
